operational_costs.deployment_artifacts: none: a calibration case of the bench only; pl-worker is the same binary as for option-chain-greeks
operational_costs.observability: bench evidence only (per-row cgroup CPU, route label, raw blocks)
operational_costs.failure_handling: a failed echo call fails its row in evidence; nothing falls back to another route
operational_costs.retries_idempotency: an echo request has no state, so a repeat is idempotent; the bench never retries a failed call
operational_costs.ownership_abi: the example project owns the worker protocol and its --echo option
operational_costs.native_boundary_maintenance: the 23 project gates, sanitizers and fuzz replay on each change of pl-worker
